He had disappeared at sea twenty years earlier. All day she watched the horizon, forgetting her tea and leaving the radio unanswered. At midnight, fog swallowed the headland. He smiled once before the light swept onward, leaving only an empty sea.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯照着空荡的街口，便利店里传来冰柜低沉的嗡鸣。清洁工推着车经过，扫帚拂起昨夜的落叶。远处，一辆货车驶向市场，车灯划破薄雾。早餐铺的蒸笼渐渐冒出白气，第一班公交还没到站。有人刚刚入睡，有人已经出门，而天边正悄悄泛白。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no smaller box inside."}
